intent: A shade-bride's Grashan feast gown: a rich gold brocade bodice and short gold overskirt over an ivory bell skirt, slim ivory sleeves, a tall gold crown with one amber gem, and shade creeping up the hem, reading gold and ivory from the high camera.
requests: A translucent cloth material for a face veil; parts hold only colour, so the veil is opaque and the amber eyes sit on it.
A cone or tapered skirt primitive; flat panels leave corner gaps, so the skirt needs hidden core boxes to keep the legs covered.
